problems.problem: GPU resources are not being utilized or performing efficiently enough at the scale required for Claude and large language models.
evidence: maximizing GPU utilization and performance at unprecedented scale
developing cutting-edge optimizations that directly enable new model capabilities and dramatically improve inference efficiency
Have deep experience with GPU programming and optimization at scale
problems.rationale: The company needs to improve GPU utilization, throughput, and inference efficiency across extremely large ML workloads.

problems.problem: The existing systems need lower-level GPU and kernel optimizations to overcome performance bottlenecks.
evidence: implement state-of-the-art techniques from custom kernel development
GPU Kernel Development: CUDA, Triton, CUTLASS, Flash Attention, tensor core optimization
Performance Engineering: Kernel fusion, memory bandwidth optimization, profiling with Nsight
problems.rationale: The emphasis on custom kernels, tensor cores, fusion, memory bandwidth, and profiling indicates unresolved low-level execution bottlenecks.

problems.problem: The ML software stack needs deeper compiler and framework-level optimization and integration.
evidence: you'll architect and implement the foundational systems that power Claude
Can navigate complex systems from hardware interfaces to high-level ML frameworks
ML Compilers & Frameworks: PyTorch/JAX internals, torch.compile, XLA, custom operators
problems.rationale: The role is intended to address performance limitations spanning GPU hardware interfaces, compilers, frameworks, and custom operators.

problems.problem: Distributed GPU execution must be coordinated more efficiently across thousands of GPUs.
evidence: orchestrating thousands of GPUs in perfect synchronization
Distributed Systems: NCCL, NVLink, collective communication, model parallelism
problems.rationale: The need to synchronize thousands of GPUs and manage collective communication indicates challenges in scaling distributed training and inference.

problems.problem: Large-scale ML infrastructure needs improved precision efficiency, reliability, and operational resilience.
evidence: Production Systems: Large-scale training infrastructure, fault tolerance, cluster orchestration
Strong candidates will have a track record of delivering transformative GPU performance improvements in production ML systems
problems.rationale: The listing points to production demands for lower-precision computation, fault tolerance, and reliable orchestration while maintaining major performance gains.
